title: fix(objectql)!: a field's picklist resolves from the package that declares it; the api index keeps one item per package and name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92EgaXEnM5vQrniaS8pq3eQ)_

Part of #31678

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Narrowing: yes. (1) D3 (a): a package field whose `picklist` only an environment-authored item holds is served with no options and its values are refused. (2) The general outside-closure case, ruled inside ADR-0150 D3 step 3: a package field whose `picklist` another package holds, with no declared dependency on that package, is refused the same way. N1 is ruled on #31678 (the declared dependency closure only), so this includes a sibling in the same artifact. First-party count: 0 for both in shipped code. No `examples/**` app and no platform package declares a picklist (only notes in `examples/app-showcase/src/coverage.ts` mention them). In first-party tests, two fixtures relied on a sibling's list with no declared dependency and get a forced `dependencies` edit (listed under Tests): `manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts` and `cli/src/utils/picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts`. HotCRM is not in this session's repository scope, so it is not measured. D3 (a) is not measurable first-party, because no environment exists there.
Skills-docs: none. The published skills never teach a field that names another package's picklist; `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` mentions picklist only for `fieldPatches`.

This PR is a **draft** until the epic seat's final check. N1 is ruled and R2 #31733 has landed, so nothing is held red on this head.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：字段上的 `picklist` 名称现在按“声明该字段的包”去解析（自己的包 → 已声明依赖的包 + sys → 拒绝），统一走 ADR-0150 的包作用域解析器；同一发布包内的兄弟包也必须声明依赖（N1 已裁决）；api 端点索引改为按（包, 名称）各留一条。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D3 要求同名元数据按引用方的包解析，不能再靠“先注册先得”或环境里的同名条目。
- 风险与回滚：收窄。包字段引用了只有环境条目持有的列表，或引用了未声明依赖的其他包（含兄弟包）的列表，会变成无选项、值被拒；启动只告警不失败，启动后安装会被拒。线上第一方计数为 0；两个测试夹具补了依赖声明。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 中的 `picklistReferrerOf` 与 `picklistReferenceVerdict`，以及 `plugin.ts` 中启动审计的告警分支和安装判定。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-picklist.test.ts src/plugin-picklist-boot-audit.test.ts src/manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts`，看 “ADR-0150 D3” 相关 describe 全绿。
- 需要你做的：无。席位在史诗最终检查通过后落地。

## What changes

**Picklist, by the referrer's package (`@objectstack/objectql`).** Every picklist lookup now calls R's `resolvePackageScopedName` (type `picklist`), which since R2 #31733 is an adapter over the lean core rule and `packageResolutionClosure`. There is no second closure walk, no id-prefix reading and no first-registered fallback on any touched path.

- A field's `picklist` resolves with the package that declares that field as the caller. The referrers are every packaged `own` or `extend` contributor that declares that `picklist` on that field (`picklistReferrerOf`). The field is served only when every referrer reaches the same holder; otherwise it is served no options. There is no fold-order pick. A field written only by an environment-authored body (a tenant overlay, an object created in Studio) has no package, so it resolves environment-wide, as before.
- A `picklistExtensions` entry's `extend` resolves caller-less (the epic seat's ruling X on this card). An extension still adds its options to the one list its `extend` names in the environment, whether or not its package depends on that list's package. Extensions are folded onto a field's list only when the caller-less holder is the same holder the field resolved.
- The boot audit (`kernel:ready`) still throws for a reference no holder can satisfy (not found, ambiguous). For **every** outside-closure refusal (an environment-only list, or a package outside the declared closure, a sibling included) it **warns** and the boot goes on (ruling N2). The read serves that field no options and the validator refuses its values.
- The post-seal install judge (the manifest service) judges each pending field reference with its package as caller, through a registry view that overlays the pending artifact's manifests and their lists, and hands the walk the registered residual owners' declared dependencies (ADR-0130 D4, read through R2's `residualOwnerDependenciesOf`). A manifest's own lists short-circuit. It refuses loudly, carrying R's refusal message, which names every holder. Extension targets are judged caller-less.
- `describeUnresolvedPicklistReferences` appends R's refusal to each line. Its headline is unchanged.

**The api endpoint index, by (package, name) (`@objectstack/metadata`).** `MetadataManager.listForIndex('api')` (the matcher's `listApiItems` and the anonymous-flow-door audit) now keeps one slot per (package, name) instead of one per bare name. A package-less row under a name exactly one package holds is that package's customization, so it keeps sharing that slot (first entry wins, registry before loaders, as before). An environment-only row has its own slot. There is no resolver call there: `@objectstack/metadata` cannot import R (objectql depends on it), and the request side is caller-less. The route grammar and precedence are untouched (they belong to G1 and the router).

### Every by-name reader and the referrer it now passes

| Reader | Referrer package passed |
|:--|:--|
| `SchemaRegistry.resolvePicklistFields` through `finishServedObject` (every served object, from `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` and the no-extenders branch of `foldObjectExtendersOnto`) | every declaring packaged contributor's `packageId` (`picklistReferrerOf`), served only when all reach one holder; `null` when only an environment-authored body declares the field |
| `SchemaRegistry.resolvePicklistOptions(name, callerPackageId?)` | the caller's argument; omitted means package-less |
| `SchemaRegistry.findUnresolvedPicklistReferences` / `findOutsideClosurePicklistReferences` (boot audit, `plugin.ts` `kernel:ready`) | each packaged contributor's `packageId` |
| `SchemaRegistry.findOrphanPicklistExtensions` (boot audit) | none (caller-less, ruling X) |
| `registerPicklistExtension` / `assertPicklistValuesDistinct` | none (caller-less, ruling X) |
| post-seal install judge (`plugin.ts`, manifest service) | field refs: the pending package's id, with the pending manifests overlaid; extensions: none |
| `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, save door) | none: a package-less caller per R. Not in this card's surface, so not edited |
| `cli/src/utils/seed-record-values.ts` | none: a package-less caller per R. Not in this card's surface, so not edited |
| `MetadataManager.listForIndex('api')` → `EndpointMatcher` | none: requests are caller-less. The key is now (package, name), not the bare name |

**Not in this PR.**
- Functions: engine functions by package came with R2 #31733; nothing more here.
- Mapping and dataset: no package-referrer reader exists in this card's surface. Their doors (rest `import-mapping.ts`, `analytics-routes.ts`) and service-analytics' cube-name reads resolve as package-less callers per R. There is no code for them here.

That is why the first line says `Part of`, not `Fixes`.

## Tests

New pins, each ablation-verified.

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-picklist.test.ts`, describe `picklist — resolved from the package that writes the reference (ADR-0150 D3)`:
  - D3 (a): an environment-only list, so the field is served no options, the validator refuses, and `findOutsideClosurePicklistReferences` names it.
  - Outside the closure: `findUnresolvedPicklistReferences` is empty and `findOutsideClosurePicklistReferences` names the field, with R's refusal naming `package "com.test.lists"`.
  - CONTROL: with a declared dependency, the list is served.
  - CONTROL: a package-less referrer is served the environment list.
  - Two packages writing one field's reference: served no options unless both reach the list. CONTROL: both depending on the list's package are served it.
  - An extension extends caller-less with no dependency.
- `packages/objectql/src/plugin-picklist-boot-audit.test.ts`:
  - describe `the picklist boot audit — a list only the environment holds (ADR-0150 D3 (a))`: the boot succeeds and serves no options; a late artifact is refused, naming the environment; CONTROL: with a dependency, it registers; a list held by a package outside the closure boots with a warning and no options.
  - describe `the picklist install door — a sibling in the same artifact (ADR-0150 D3)`: a sibling's list with no declared dependency is refused, naming that sibling. CONTROL: with the dependency, the artifact registers.
- `packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts`: after start(), a package depending on the residual owner reaches the list its dependency holds.
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`, describe `the endpoint index keeps one slot per (package, name) (ADR-0150 D4)`:
  - Two packages' same-named items are both served.
  - CONTROL: a package-less row shares the holder slot, and the first one wins.
  - CONTROL: an environment-only row is served.

**Forced test edits** (fixtures that relied on outside-closure resolution, which D3 step 3 and the N1 ruling now refuse):
- `engine-picklist.test.ts`: the `HEALTH` app gains `dependencies: { 'com.test.picklist.core': '^1.0.0' }`.
- `engine-picklist.test.ts`: the load-order test registers its object under `com.test.core` (the list's own package) instead of `com.test.early`.
- `plugin-picklist-boot-audit.test.ts` "boots when the list arrives…": the app gains `dependencies: { 'com.test.boot.lists': '^1.0.0' }`.
- `plugin-picklist-boot-audit.test.ts` "after the boot, an artifact that brings its own list…": `com.test.late` gains the same dependency.
- `manifest-service-residual-objects.test.ts` "a residual object whose field names a picklist a BODY declares…": the stack's `manifest` gains `dependencies: { 'com.example.acme.service': '^2.4.0' }` (N1: a sibling needs a declared dependency).
- `packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts`: the core body gains `dependencies: { 'com.example.parity.app': '^1.0.0' }` (N1, same reason).

**Red on `main`.** The first round's pins were run against `main`'s source:
- engine-picklist: two red (`expected [{Gold}] to be undefined`); its three controls pass.
- boot audit: two red (`expected ['technology'] to deeply equal []`, `expected [Function] to throw`); its control passes.
- api index: one red (`expected undefined to be 'b'`); its two controls pass.

The two-referrer, sibling-door and boot-warning pins guard this PR's own rules (on `main` a sibling's list resolves first-registered), so their proof is the ablations below. The residual-owner pin is green on `main` too (no closure check there) and guards the install view; its proof is ablation 7.

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; restored each time, blob equal to HEAD):
1. Drop the referrer (always caller-less): two pins red.
2. Fold the boot's environment-held arm back into the throwing set: one red.
3. Remove the api `byPackage` delegation: one red.
4. Keep only the last referrer (the old fold-order pick): the two-referrer pin red.
5. Judge the install with the whole artifact's lists as every manifest's own: the sibling-door pin red.
6. Warn only for environment-held refusals (N2 for the environment only): three red.
7. Drop `residualOwnerDependenciesOf` from the install view: the residual-owner pin red (refused at install, "held outside the declared dependency closure of package \"com.example.late\"").

## Acceptance notes

**Red line 3.**
- (a) Phase-1 one-holder suites are green and untouched: `registry-bare-name-one-holder.test.ts`, `-ai-family`, `-flow-family`, `-request-family`, and `package-scoped-resolver.test.ts`. `bare-name-one-holder.ts` and `package-scoped-resolver.ts` are not edited.
- (b) Bare-name behaviour (URL, MCP, SDK) is unchanged for every name with one holder, except the declared narrowings above. A package field whose list its own package or its closure holds is served exactly as before. A package-less caller resolves through R's package-less rule (the environment item first, then the unique holder), and the CONTROL pin shows it is served the same list as on `main`. Api routes answer as before while each api name has one package holder.
- (c) No migration. No key or stored shape changes. ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the changeset.
- (d) `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, above and in the changeset, with a **BREAKING** banner.

**Holds cleared.** N1 is ruled on #31678 (declared closure only): the residual test is green with its forced edit. R2 #31733 landed: the core-boundary ratchet and `check:lean-entry-closure` are green with no change here beyond reading R2's new `platform` holder kind in `sameHolder`.

**Open questions (seat's call).** New names: `findOutsideClosurePicklistReferences`, `picklistReferenceVerdict`, and the `byPackage` option of the private `listForIndex`. Types: `PicklistFieldResolver`, `UnresolvedPicklistReference`, `UnresolvedPicklistExtension`.

## Verification

Head: `bf7e3295e9ed0c6ca46217e172e25ed5f4aeaee7`.

Everything below ran on this head, after merging `main` at `2b752aa4f` (R2 #31733 included).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 577 files and 11821 tests pass, 0 red (the core-boundary ratchet and the residual test included).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata test`: 71 files and 987 tests pass.
- `packages/cli` `seed-record-values.test.ts`, `picklist-references.test.ts`, `picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts`: 3 files and 48 tests pass. `seed-record-values` was red only against a stale objectql build; it is green once objectql is rebuilt.
- `typecheck` for `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/metadata` and `@objectstack/cli`: exit 0. The cli `check:test-typecheck` step ran out of the default 2 GB Node heap in this container on the first run and passes with `--max-old-space-size=6144`.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on every changed `.ts` file: exit 0.
- Full `pnpm turbo run build`: 120 of 120 tasks succeed.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 75 derived, 75 run, 0 not measured, 0 unrun, every one exit 0. `check:lean-entry-closure` holds its admitted set (15 packages, no denied name) for both `@objectstack/objectql/core` conditions.
- Dogfood battery (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`): 440 files and 3654 tests pass, 3 files skipped.
- CI on this head: every check green.
- Red on `main` and the seven ablations are listed under Tests.
